build_chunk_fwd_o: build a chunked forward pass for linear attention using q, k, v, h tensors with optional scale and chunk size
run_chunk_fwd_kernel_o: run the Triton JIT kernel for chunked linear attention forward with block pointers and boundary checks
test_chunk_fwd_o: test the chunk_fwd_o function with variable-length sequences using cu_seqlens and chunk_indices
review_chunk_fwd_kernel_o: review the chunk_fwd_kernel_o Triton kernel for gated linear attention with USE_G and IS_VARLEN modes
configure_chunk_fwd_bkv: configure BKV_LIST and NUM_WARPS block sizes and warp counts based on shared memory and hardware detection
